text:
Situation: Corvale East has 64 vials of phenylephrine hydrochloride 10 mg/mL 1 mL with 10.8 days on hand. Corvale General has 125 vials with 21.3 days on hand. Daily use is 5.9 vials at each site.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show phenylephrine hydrochloride is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers immediate needs at both sites. No FDA shortage listing exists. Proactive purchasing from a qualified supplier will prevent a future supply gap at Corvale East.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places an order with Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc. for delivery to Corvale East; Pharmacy Director approves the purchase.
2. Buyer places an order with Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC as a backup source; Pharmacy Director approves the purchase.
3. Buyer evaluates Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. if the first two options are unavailable; Pharmacy Director approves the purchase.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until Corvale East stock falls below seven days. Expanding purchases to Method Pharmaceuticals, LLC or Sandoz Inc. before the top three options are exhausted.
